compiler.aot: every namespace AOT-compiled (script/compile.clj); verified: no namespace compiled or loaded from source at run time (-Xlog:class+load)
compiler.lint: make lint compiles with *warn-on-reflection* and *unchecked-math* :warn-on-boxed and fails on any reflection, boxed-math or performance warning

build.jar: target/polyquery.jar (the JDK AOT cache only covers classes loaded from jar files)
build.aot_cache: make build records target/polyquery.aot with -XX:AOTCacheOutput by replaying a synthetic training session (script/training.clj: generated tables, generic queries) through bin/polyquery; training failure leaves no cache and the build still succeeds

launcher_jvm_flags: -XX:AOTCache=target/polyquery.aot (only when the file exists; -Xlog:aot*=off,cds*=off so a stale or unusable cache is ignored silently)
-XX:+UseParallelGC (kept from the accepted engine; G1 and Serial measured, not better)
code: boxed arithmetic removed from every namespace (primitive locals, ^:const constants)
sort: one comparator type switching on key kind (no megamorphic per-key calls, no boxing), 8-byte UTF-8 prefixes for string keys, merge-path parallel merges, parallel key extraction
positions-where is a macro (no boxed predicate call per row); no not= on primitives in hot loops
MIN/MAX states and comparators branch on the sign instead of a checked multiplication
